{"number": 891, "title": "README: name the decision policy where it says what the maintainer keeps (spec 030)", "body": "Spec 030's Docs section says `README.md` "names the policy where it describes what the maintainer keeps". That reads two ways, and both meet the spec:

1. One sentence pointing to the policy: what the maintainer keeps is the zones at `ask` and `never`, which `shipmill decide levels` lists
2. The zones themselves, inline: `direction` and `decision-policy` never, and `scope`, `rule-departure`, `contract-change`, `security`, and `protected` asked

Pick a reading and build it.", "state": "open", "user": {"login": "romamo", "type": "User"}, "author_association": "OWNER", "labels": [], "comments": 0, "created_at": "2026-10-25T09:00:00Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/shipmill/shipmill/issues/891"}
